skills.summary: Design clean React components
skills.job: Split a UI into components with clear props, state ownership and composition.
triggers: how should I split this component

skills.summary: Debug broken CSS layouts
skills.job: Find why a flex, grid or positioned layout misbehaves and fix the cause.
gotchas: percentage heights without a sized parent

skills.summary: Audit a page across screen sizes
skills.job: Check a page at phone, tablet and desktop widths and list breakages.
triggers: it looks wrong on my phone
gotchas: testing only by dragging the window

skills.summary: Build a design token system
skills.job: Turn scattered colors, spacing and type values into named tokens.
gotchas: tokens that skip a semantic layer

skills.summary: Design forms with good validation
skills.job: Make form validation timely, specific and recoverable.

skills.summary: Review frontend state handling
skills.job: Decide where each piece of UI state should live and remove redundant state.
gotchas: server data copied into client state

skills.summary: Set and enforce a page weight budget
skills.job: Define byte and timing budgets for a page and check the build against them.
triggers: why is the site slow to load
gotchas: testing only on a fast laptop

skills.summary: Fix janky animations
skills.job: Find and fix animations that drop frames or trigger layout.

skills.summary: Add dark mode and theme switching
skills.job: Add a light and dark theme with system preference and a user override.
gotchas: flash of wrong theme on load
hardcoded colors in images and SVG

skills.summary: Design loading, empty and error states
skills.job: Cover the non-happy-path states of a data view.
triggers: what should the empty state show
gotchas: empty state shown while still loading

skills.summary: Prepare a UI for translation
skills.job: Find hardcoded strings and locale assumptions and make the UI translatable.
gotchas: fixed-width layouts breaking on long text

skills.summary: Find what bloats the JS bundle
skills.job: Analyze a build and cut the largest avoidable dependencies and chunks.

skills.summary: Audit a shared component library
skills.job: Check a component library for duplicates, inconsistent APIs and missing states.
gotchas: counting usage by file name only

skills.summary: Fix technical SEO in page markup
skills.job: Check titles, meta tags, headings, canonical links and structured data in HTML.
gotchas: content rendered only by client JS
canonical pointing to the wrong URL

skills.summary: Check browser support for web features
skills.job: Decide whether a CSS or JS feature is safe for the target browsers.
triggers: can I use this CSS feature

skills.summary: Make forms usable with assistive tech
skills.job: Fix labels, errors, grouping and focus in forms for screen reader and keyboard users.
gotchas: error text not linked to its field

skills.summary: Test a UI with the keyboard only
skills.job: Walk a page with Tab and arrow keys and list focus and operability problems.
triggers: can I use this without a mouse
gotchas: focus lost after a modal closes
custom widgets missing arrow key support

skills.summary: Fix Core Web Vitals issues
skills.job: Diagnose LCP, CLS and INP problems and apply targeted fixes.
gotchas: lab scores treated as field data

skills.summary: Set up a consistent SVG icon system
skills.job: Standardize icon sizes, colors and delivery across a project.
triggers: how should I load SVG icons

skills.summary: Clean up Tailwind class sprawl
skills.job: Reduce repeated utility strings and conflicting classes in Tailwind markup.
gotchas: dynamic class names purged at build
conflicting utilities depending on CSS order
